sources.title: Gemma 4 31B - Cerebras Inference
sources.snippet: Gemma 4 31B This model excels at multimodal reasoning across screenshots, documents, diagrams, and design assets. Ideal for visual agentic workflows, image-aware copilots, and teams migrating from closed multimodal APIs to an open model.
